headline: Battle Lines Stir Along Contested Fronts
war_summary: The latest returns show the great struggle easing at several flashpoints while fresh pressure builds elsewhere. Godcrofts remains the busiest recorded sector, with 46 strategic-base events in 24 hours, though its two-hour tally has fallen from the previous edition’s surge to four; the map now shows five Colonial, one Warden, and three neutral positions. PalantineBerm likewise remains unsettled at 44 daily events and two in the latest two hours, with four Colonial and three Warden bases. MarbanHollow has quieted sharply in the immediate window, but seven events in six hours and 37 in the day leave four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral base. LinnMercy has gone quiet for two hours after its earlier burst, retaining eight Colonial, two Warden, and one neutral positions. WeatheredExpanse records one event in six hours and 34 in the day, with six Warden and three neutral bases. FarranacCoast is the newer alarm bell: two events in two hours, nine in the day, and sharply accelerating casualties and enlistments, despite all eleven bases presently Colonial.
